t: When you are told to be patient and it is hard
a: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
p: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanu-staʿīnū bi-ṣ-ṣabri wa-ṣ-ṣalāh, inna-llāha maʿa-ṣ-ṣābirīn.
m: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allāh is with the patient.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
